extracted.intended_audience: romance writers (RWA members and prospective members); potential judges, mentors, workshop contributors, and board candidates
extracted.subtask_description: Organizational guidance and participation requirements for Romance Writers of America (RWA) activities, including membership benefits, award judging, mentorship (RAMP), RWA University submissions, and Board candidacy. The page describes expectations, roles, and procedural deadlines rather than creative-writing craft rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Safe and respectful environment / Non-discrimination policy
rubrics_metrics.description: RWA is committed to providing all of its members with an environment free from discrimination and harassment. RWA does not discriminate against or allow harassment of any member based on race, ethnicity, religion, color, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, gender identity or expression, ancestry, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by law.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To create a safe and respectful environment, discrimination and harassment of any sort is prohibited in RWA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Qualifications sought for Golden Heart & Diamond Heart judges
rubrics_metrics.description: We're seeking experienced readers and professionals with a passion for happily-ever-afters, a commitment to fair and thoughtful critiques, and a willingness to uphold RWA’s core values.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sign up to judge the Golden Heart and Diamond Heart Awards to help recognize excellence in published and unpublished romance; judges should be prepared to provide fair, thoughtful critiques and to follow organizational values.

rubrics_metrics.name: RAMP mentor role and expectations
rubrics_metrics.description: RAMP mentors help prepublished writers polish manuscripts, prepare submissions, and build their confidence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mentors are expected to 'lift up the next generation of romance authors' by offering manuscript-level guidance, submission preparation assistance, and confidence-building support; details and sign-up available via the RAMP information link.

rubrics_metrics.name: RWA University submission content types
rubrics_metrics.description: Have a tip, guide, or workshop idea to share with romance writers? Submit your Author Survival Guides, Writing for Writers Guides, 2-Minute Tips, or Workshop proposals to RWA University today.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: RWA University accepts specific formats (Author Survival Guides, Writing for Writers, 2-Minute Tips, workshop proposals); contributors should follow the submission process linked from the RWA University logo for format details and requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Board candidacy declaration requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Members interested in running for a Board position must declare their intent to run by completing and electronically submitting an Election Certification Form by June 23, 2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Questions about running for the Board should be submitted through the CONTACT US form; candidates must meet the stated deadline and submit the required Election Certification Form electronically.

rubrics_metrics.name: Awards purpose: Golden Heart and Diamond Heart recognize excellence
rubrics_metrics.description: The Golden Heart and Diamond Heart Awards help recognize excellence in both published and unpublished romance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These awards are secured through judging panels (see judge qualifications); participation as a judge supports the recognition of excellence across published and unpublished works.
